Data science sits at the center of our product, pricing, and lifecycle decisions—helping teams distinguish genuine member value from statistical noise.

The Role

What You Will Do

jds.text:
About Ironclad Financial
Ironclad Financial provides real-time treasury, clearing, and multi-currency payout infrastructure for thousands of B2B platforms and marketplaces. Our core ledger and settlement engines move billions of dollars each month with strict correctness, auditability, and uptime guarantees.

The Role
We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer for our Core Payments & Ledger team. You will architect and operate distributed microservices, event-driven settlement pipelines, and high-throughput APIs where every transaction must be accounted for accurately.

What You Will Do

Requirements (Must-Haves)

Nice-to-Haves

jds.title: Senior Computer Vision & Robotics Perception Engineer
